★ This week’s partner spotlight

Marlow Community Baseball League

Artesian Springs is proud to partner with our local community baseball league, supporting a program that brings families together, teaches teamwork, and gives young athletes the chance to grow both on and off the field.

We’re especially excited that Artesian Springs is now available at the concession stand — a refreshing local choice for athletes, families, and fans on game night.

Read the full spotlight →

On game nights, the ballpark truly comes alive. Families fill the stands, players take the field with excitement, and the air is filled with classic ballpark favorites — from hot dogs and popcorn to snow cones and ice-cold drinks. At the heart of it all is the concession stand. More than a place for snacks, it provides jobs for local kids and creates a welcoming space where connections are made and memories are shared.

Our story

Water with a real place behind it.

Artesian Springs is local, family-owned, and rooted in Rush Springs, Oklahoma — from the well we trust to the bottles we share with our communities.

About Artesian Springs

Local water.
A family behind every bottle.

We are a local, family-owned business built on something simple: clean, natural water sourced straight from our well in Rush Springs, OK.

For us, this isn’t just a product. It’s personal. Our water comes from the same source we trust for our own families. We believe you should know where your water comes from and who stands behind it.

Being family-owned means we pay attention to the details. From sourcing to bottling, we focus on quality, consistency, and doing things the right way — not the fastest way.

When you choose us, you’re supporting a local business, a real family, and water that comes from the ground, not a factory.

Deep Source, Pure Taste.
Why Artesian Springs?

What matters to us, from source to sip.

The same three ideas you see on our home page are the principles behind how we operate every day.

Well-Sourced

Our water comes directly from our own well in Rush Springs, Oklahoma. That connection to the source gives us something increasingly rare: a clear answer when someone asks where their water comes from.

Family Owned

Artesian Springs is run by a real local family, not a distant corporate brand. We care about every partnership, every order, and the quality of the product because our name and our community are attached to it.

Exceptionally Pure

We keep the focus where it belongs: clean, naturally sourced water, consistent quality, and a straightforward product we feel good about serving to our own families and yours.

Get in touch

We’d love to hear from you.

Questions about Artesian Springs, local availability, wholesale orders, or community partnerships? Reach out directly and our family will get you pointed in the right direction.
